Three files in the repository contain the literal string `GracePeriodTime`, all under the OrderProcessor project:

1. `src/OrderProcessor/BackgroundTaskOptions.cs:5` — declares the option property: `public int GracePeriodTime { get; set; }`
2. `src/OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs:72` and `:74` — two occurrences: the SQL parameter placeholder `@GracePeriodTime` in the `WHERE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - "OrderDate" >= @GracePeriodTime AND "OrderStatus" = 'Submitted'` clause, and the parameter binding `command.Parameters.AddWithValue("GracePeriodTime", TimeSpan.FromMinutes(_options.GracePeriodTime))` (which itself mentions the name twice on one line).
3. `src/OrderProcessor/appsettings.json:15` — the configuration value `"GracePeriodTime": "1",`

Method: I ran a ripgrep content search across the repo and cross-checked with a recursive `grep -rIl` that ignores only `.git`, so build-output and gitignored files were also covered; both produced the same three files. Note the search was case-sensitive for the exact literal, so differently-cased variants (e.g. `graceperiodtime`) would not appear.
